[Credit Risk]{.project-tag}

### [Credit Risk & Capital Modeling](credit-risk.qmd)

End-to-end PD/LGD/EAD framework on Lending Club consumer loans, assessed
against Basel III IRB, IFRS 9, and SR 11-7 expectations. Benchmarks WOE/IV
scorecards against LightGBM and a Merton structural model, then runs
Gaussian copula Monte Carlo for expected loss and regulatory capital across
the full portfolio.

[Python]{.badge} [LightGBM]{.badge} [Survival Analysis]{.badge} [Monte Carlo]{.badge}

[Equity Research]{.project-tag}

### [Alternative Data Equity Signals](alpha-research.qmd)

Multi-factor alpha research combining SEC EDGAR filing sentiment
(Loughran-McDonald), Google Trends attention data, and options market
positioning. Signals evaluated with Fama-MacBeth regressions, information
coefficient analysis, and long-short decile backtests.

[Python]{.badge} [NLP]{.badge} [Factor Research]{.badge} [Backtesting]{.badge}
